mapper.select: SELECT CATEGORY_NO AS categoryNo, CATEGORY_NAME AS categoryName, CREATED_AT AS createdAt FROM OFT_PRODUCT_CATEGORY ORDER BY CATEGORY_NAME ASC

SELECT p.PRODUCT_NO AS productNo, p.CATEGORY_NO AS categoryNo, c.CATEGORY_NAME AS categoryName, p.PRODUCT_NAME AS productName, p.ORIGIN AS origin, p.UNIT AS unit, p.PACKAGE_WEIGHT AS packageWeight, p.SALE_PRICE AS salePrice, p.STOCK_QTY AS stockQty, p.DESCRIPTION AS description, p.IS_SEASONAL AS isSeasonal, p.SALE_STATUS AS saleStatus, p.CREATED_AT AS createdAt, p.UPDATED_AT AS updatedAt FROM OFT_PRODUCT p JOIN OFT_PRODUCT_CATEGORY c ON c.CATEGORY_NO = p.CATEGORY_NO ORDER BY p.UPDATED_AT DESC, p.PRODUCT_NO DESC

SELECT p.PRODUCT_NO AS productNo, p.CATEGORY_NO AS categoryNo, c.CATEGORY_NAME AS categoryName, p.PRODUCT_NAME AS productName, p.ORIGIN AS origin, p.UNIT AS unit, p.PACKAGE_WEIGHT AS packageWeight, p.SALE_PRICE AS salePrice, p.STOCK_QTY AS stockQty, p.DESCRIPTION AS description, p.IS_SEASONAL AS isSeasonal, p.SALE_STATUS AS saleStatus, p.CREATED_AT AS createdAt, p.UPDATED_AT AS updatedAt FROM OFT_PRODUCT p JOIN OFT_PRODUCT_CATEGORY c ON c.CATEGORY_NO = p.CATEGORY_NO WHERE p.PRODUCT_NO = #{_parameter}

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT p.PRODUCT_NO AS productNo, p.CATEGORY_NO AS categoryNo, c.CATEGORY_NAME AS categoryName, p.PRODUCT_NAME AS productName, p.ORIGIN AS origin, p.UNIT AS unit, p.PACKAGE_WEIGHT AS packageWeight, p.SALE_PRICE AS salePrice, p.STOCK_QTY AS stockQty, p.DESCRIPTION AS description, p.IS_SEASONAL AS isSeasonal, p.SALE_STATUS AS saleStatus, p.CREATED_AT AS createdAt, p.UPDATED_AT AS updatedAt FROM OFT_PRODUCT p JOIN OFT_PRODUCT_CATEGORY c ON c.CATEGORY_NO = p.CATEGORY_NO WHERE p.CATEGORY_NO = #{categoryNo} AND p.PRODUCT_NAME = #{productName} AND NVL(p.ORIGIN, ' ') = NVL(#{origin}, ' ') AND p.UNIT = #{unit} AND p.PACKAGE_WEIGHT = #{packageWeight} AND p.SALE_PRICE = #{salePrice} AND p.STOCK_QTY = #{stockQty} AND p.IS_SEASONAL = #{isSeasonal} AND p.SALE_STATUS = #{saleStatus} ORDER BY p.PRODUCT_NO DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO OFT_PRODUCT ( CATEGORY_NO, PRODUCT_NAME, ORIGIN, UNIT, PACKAGE_WEIGHT, SALE_PRICE, STOCK_QTY, DESCRIPTION, IS_SEASONAL, SALE_STATUS ) VALUES ( #{categoryNo}, #{productName}, #{origin}, #{unit}, #{packageWeight}, #{salePrice}, #{stockQty}, #{description}, #{isSeasonal}, #{saleStatus} )
mapper.update: UPDATE OFT_PRODUCT SET CATEGORY_NO = #{categoryNo}, PRODUCT_NAME = #{productName}, ORIGIN = #{origin}, UNIT = #{unit}, PACKAGE_WEIGHT = #{packageWeight}, SALE_PRICE = #{salePrice}, STOCK_QTY = #{stockQty}, DESCRIPTION = #{description}, IS_SEASONAL = #{isSeasonal}, SALE_STATUS = #{saleStatus} WHERE PRODUCT_NO = #{productNo}
mapper.select: SELECT PRODUCT_NO AS productNo, IMAGE_NO AS imageNo, IMAGE_NAME AS imageName, IMAGE_EXT AS imageExt, MIME_TYPE AS mimeType, IMAGE_SIZE AS imageSize, SORT_ORDER AS sortOrder, IS_MAIN AS isMain, CREATED_AT AS createdAt FROM OFT_PRODUCT_IMAGE WHERE PRODUCT_NO = #{_parameter} ORDER BY SORT_ORDER ASC, IMAGE_NO ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO OFT_PRODUCT_IMAGE ( PRODUCT_NO, IMAGE_NAME, IMAGE_EXT, MIME_TYPE, IMAGE_SIZE, IMAGE_DATA, SORT_ORDER, IS_MAIN ) VALUES ( #{productNo}, #{imageName}, #{imageExt}, #{mimeType}, #{imageSize}, #{imageData, jdbcType=BLOB}, #{sortOrder}, #{isMain} )

INSERT INTO OFT_PRODUCT_PRICE_CODE_MAP ( PRODUCT_NO, MARKET_TYPE, ITEM_CATEGORY_CODE, ITEM_CODE, KIND_CODE, PRODUCT_RANK_CODE, COUNTRY_CODE, CONVERT_KG_YN, ITEM_NAME_HINT, UNIT_HINT, IS_ACTIVE ) VALUES ( #{productNo}, #{marketType}, #{itemCategoryCode}, #{itemCode}, #{kindCode}, #{productRankCode}, #{countryCode}, #{convertKgYn}, #{itemNameHint}, #{unitHint}, 'Y' )
mapper.select: SELECT o.ORDER_NO AS orderNo, o.USER_NO AS userNo, o.ORDER_ID AS orderId, o.ORDERED_AT AS orderedAt, o.ORDER_STATUS AS orderStatus, o.RECIPIENT_NAME AS recipientName, o.RECIPIENT_PHONE AS recipientPhone, NVL(d.DELIVERY_STATUS, 'READY') AS deliveryStatus, CASE WHEN oi.ITEM_COUNT <= 1 THEN oi.FIRST_PRODUCT_NAME ELSE oi.FIRST_PRODUCT_NAME || ' 외 ' || TO_CHAR(oi.ITEM_COUNT - 1) || '건' END AS displayProductName, oi.ITEM_COUNT AS itemCount, o.FINAL_AMOUNT AS finalAmount, oi.TOTAL_SAVED_AMOUNT AS totalSavedAmount, p.PAYMENT_METHOD AS paymentMethod, p.PAYMENT_STATUS AS paymentStatus, p.PAID_AMOUNT AS paidAmount, d.TRACKING_NO AS trackingNo, d.COURIER_NAME AS courierName FROM OFT_ORDERS o LEFT JOIN OFT_DELIVERY d ON d.ORDER_NO = o.ORDER_NO LEFT JOIN OFT_PAYMENT p ON p.ORDER_NO = o.ORDER_NO JOIN ( SELECT agg.ORDER_NO, firstItem.PRODUCT_NAME AS FIRST_PRODUCT_NAME, agg.ITEM_COUNT, agg.TOTAL_SAVED_AMOUNT FROM ( SELECT ORDER_NO, COUNT(*) AS ITEM_COUNT, SUM(NVL(SAVED_AMOUNT, 0)) AS TOTAL_SAVED_AMOUNT, MIN(ORDER_ITEM_NO) AS FIRST_ORDER_ITEM_NO FROM OFT_ORDER_ITEM GROUP BY ORDER_NO ) agg JOIN OFT_ORDER_ITEM firstItem ON firstItem.ORDER_ITEM_NO = agg.FIRST_ORDER_ITEM_NO ) oi ON oi.ORDER_NO = o.ORDER_NO ORDER BY o.ORDERED_AT DESC, o.ORDER_NO DESC

SELECT o.ORDER_NO AS orderNo, o.USER_NO AS userNo, o.ORDER_ID AS orderId, o.ORDERED_AT AS orderedAt, o.ORDER_STATUS AS orderStatus, o.RECIPIENT_NAME AS recipientName, o.RECIPIENT_PHONE AS recipientPhone, o.ZIP_CODE AS zipCode, o.ADDRESS1 AS address1, o.ADDRESS2 AS address2, NVL(d.DELIVERY_STATUS, 'READY') AS deliveryStatus, d.COURIER_NAME AS courierName, d.TRACKING_NO AS trackingNo, d.SHIPPED_AT AS shippedAt, d.DELIVERED_AT AS deliveredAt, p.PAYMENT_METHOD AS paymentMethod, p.PAYMENT_STATUS AS paymentStatus, p.PAID_AT AS paidAt, p.PAID_AMOUNT AS paidAmount, o.TOTAL_AMOUNT AS totalAmount, o.DISCOUNT_AMOUNT AS discountAmount, o.DELIVERY_FEE AS deliveryFee, o.FINAL_AMOUNT AS finalAmount FROM OFT_ORDERS o LEFT JOIN OFT_DELIVERY d ON d.ORDER_NO = o.ORDER_NO LEFT JOIN OFT_PAYMENT p ON p.ORDER_NO = o.ORDER_NO WHERE o.ORDER_NO = #{_parameter}
mapper.update: UPDATE OFT_DELIVERY SET DELIVERY_STATUS = 'SHIPPING', TRACKING_NO = #{trackingNo}, COURIER_NAME = #{courierName}, SHIPPED_AT = NVL(SHIPPED_AT, SYSTIMESTAMP) WHERE ORDER_NO = #{orderNo}
UPDATE OFT_DELIVERY SET DELIVERY_STATUS = 'DELIVERED', DELIVERED_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE ORDER_NO = #{_parameter}
mapper.select: SELECT u.USER_NO AS userNo, u.USER_ID AS userId, u.NICKNAME AS nickname, u.EMAIL AS email, u.PHONE AS phone, u.PROFILE_IMAGE_URL AS profileImageUrl, ( SELECT TRIM(a.ADDRESS1 || ' ' || NVL(a.ADDRESS2, '')) FROM OFT_USER_ADDRESS a WHERE a.USER_NO = u.USER_NO AND a.IS_DEFAULT = 'Y' ) AS defaultAddress, NVL(saved.TOTAL_SAVED_AMOUNT, 0) AS totalSavedAmount, u.ROLE AS role, u.STATUS AS status, u.CREATED_AT AS createdAt, NVL(ord.TOTAL_ORDER_COUNT, 0) AS totalOrderCount, NVL(ord.TOTAL_PURCHASE_AMOUNT, 0) AS totalPurchaseAmount FROM OFT_USERS u LEFT JOIN ( SELECT o.USER_NO, COUNT(DISTINCT o.ORDER_NO) AS TOTAL_ORDER_COUNT, SUM(NVL(o.FINAL_AMOUNT, 0)) AS TOTAL_PURCHASE_AMOUNT FROM OFT_ORDERS o GROUP BY o.USER_NO ) ord ON ord.USER_NO = u.USER_NO LEFT JOIN ( SELECT o.USER_NO, SUM(NVL(oi.SAVED_AMOUNT, 0)) AS TOTAL_SAVED_AMOUNT FROM OFT_ORDERS o LEFT JOIN OFT_ORDER_ITEM oi ON oi.ORDER_NO = o.ORDER_NO GROUP BY o.USER_NO ) saved ON saved.USER_NO = u.USER_NO ORDER BY u.CREATED_AT DESC, u.USER_NO DESC

SELECT u.USER_NO AS userNo, u.USER_ID AS userId, u.NICKNAME AS nickname, u.EMAIL AS email, u.PHONE AS phone, u.PROFILE_IMAGE_URL AS profileImageUrl, ( SELECT TRIM(a.ADDRESS1 || ' ' || NVL(a.ADDRESS2, '')) FROM OFT_USER_ADDRESS a WHERE a.USER_NO = u.USER_NO AND a.IS_DEFAULT = 'Y' ) AS defaultAddress, NVL(saved.TOTAL_SAVED_AMOUNT, 0) AS totalSavedAmount, u.ROLE AS role, u.STATUS AS status, u.CREATED_AT AS createdAt, NVL(ord.TOTAL_ORDER_COUNT, 0) AS totalOrderCount, NVL(ord.TOTAL_PURCHASE_AMOUNT, 0) AS totalPurchaseAmount FROM OFT_USERS u LEFT JOIN ( SELECT o.USER_NO, COUNT(DISTINCT o.ORDER_NO) AS TOTAL_ORDER_COUNT, SUM(NVL(o.FINAL_AMOUNT, 0)) AS TOTAL_PURCHASE_AMOUNT FROM OFT_ORDERS o GROUP BY o.USER_NO ) ord ON ord.USER_NO = u.USER_NO LEFT JOIN ( SELECT o.USER_NO, SUM(NVL(oi.SAVED_AMOUNT, 0)) AS TOTAL_SAVED_AMOUNT FROM OFT_ORDERS o LEFT JOIN OFT_ORDER_ITEM oi ON oi.ORDER_NO = o.ORDER_NO GROUP BY o.USER_NO ) saved ON saved.USER_NO = u.USER_NO WHERE u.USER_NO = #{_parameter}

SELECT BATCH_NO AS batchNo, PRODUCT_NO AS productNo, CATEGORY_NO AS categoryNo, PRODUCT_NAME AS productName, ORIGIN AS origin, PURCHASE_UNIT AS purchaseUnit, PURCHASE_QTY AS purchaseQty, PURCHASE_PRICE AS purchasePrice, PURCHASE_DATE AS purchaseDate, SUPPLIER_NAME AS supplierName, STATUS AS status, CREATED_AT AS createdAt FROM OFT_PURCHASE_BATCH ORDER BY PURCHASE_DATE DESC, BATCH_NO DESC

SELECT BATCH_NO AS batchNo, PRODUCT_NO AS productNo, CATEGORY_NO AS categoryNo, PRODUCT_NAME AS productName, ORIGIN AS origin, PURCHASE_UNIT AS purchaseUnit, PURCHASE_QTY AS purchaseQty, PURCHASE_PRICE AS purchasePrice, PURCHASE_DATE AS purchaseDate, SUPPLIER_NAME AS supplierName, STATUS AS status, CREATED_AT AS createdAt FROM OFT_PURCHASE_BATCH WHERE BATCH_NO = #{_parameter}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO OFT_PURCHASE_BATCH ( PRODUCT_NO, CATEGORY_NO, PRODUCT_NAME, ORIGIN, PURCHASE_UNIT, PURCHASE_QTY, PURCHASE_PRICE, PURCHASE_DATE, SUPPLIER_NAME, STATUS ) VALUES ( #{productNo}, #{categoryNo}, #{productName}, #{origin}, #{purchaseUnit}, #{purchaseQty}, #{purchasePrice}, #{purchaseDate}, #{supplierName}, #{status} )
mapper.select: SELECT PACKAGE_NO AS packageNo, BATCH_NO AS batchNo, PRODUCT_NO AS productNo, PACKAGED_QTY AS packagedQty, PACKAGED_WEIGHT AS packagedWeight, SALE_PRICE AS salePrice, SALE_STATUS AS saleStatus, PACKAGED_AT AS packagedAt, NOTE AS note, USER_NO AS userNo FROM OFT_PACKAGE_HISTORY ORDER BY PACKAGED_AT DESC, PACKAGE_NO DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO OFT_PACKAGE_HISTORY ( BATCH_NO, PRODUCT_NO, PACKAGED_QTY, PACKAGED_WEIGHT, SALE_PRICE, SALE_STATUS, NOTE, USER_NO ) VALUES ( #{batchNo}, #{productNo}, #{packagedQty}, #{packagedWeight}, #{salePrice}, #{saleStatus}, #{note}, #{userNo} )
mapper.select: SELECT BANNER_NO AS bannerNo, TITLE AS title, IMAGE_NAME AS imageName, IMAGE_EXT AS imageExt, MIME_TYPE AS mimeType, IMAGE_SIZE AS imageSize, LINK_URL AS linkUrl, SORT_ORDER AS sortOrder, IS_ACTIVE AS isActive, STARTED_AT AS startedAt, ENDED_AT AS endedAt, CREATED_AT AS createdAt FROM OFT_MAIN_BANNER ORDER BY SORT_ORDER ASC, BANNER_NO ASC

SELECT prm.MAP_NO AS mapNo, prm.PRODUCT_NO AS productNo, p.PRODUCT_NAME AS productName, prm.RECIPE_NO AS recipeNo, r.RECIPE_NAME AS recipeName, r.DESCRIPTION AS description, r.COOK_TIME AS cookTime, r.DIFFICULTY AS difficulty, prm.MATCH_SCORE AS matchScore, r.IMAGE_URL AS imageUrl FROM OFT_PRODUCT_RECIPE_MAP prm JOIN OFT_PRODUCT p ON p.PRODUCT_NO = prm.PRODUCT_NO JOIN OFT_RECIPE r ON r.RECIPE_NO = prm.RECIPE_NO ORDER BY prm.CREATED_AT DESC, prm.MAP_NO DESC
